text:
Maya Chen: Quick ping — spotted a 403 on the Runtime onboarding KB when following the "Getting started: runtime" external example link (https://example.redwood.ai/setup). Happens in staging preview only.
Jordan Lee: Ugh, thanks. Is it the embed image or the API example URL?
Maya Chen: The API example URL 403s when the page tries to fetch the sample model manifest. Noticed during new-hire walkthru.
Priya Nair: Can someone claim this? Might be a short redirect fix or rehost the manifest in our CDN.
Sam Ortiz: I can take a look — assigning to myself. Will try to rehost or add a permanent redirect.
Maya Chen: Awesome, thanks Sam. If it's a quick rehost, can you drop a tiny PR with the updated href and a note in frontmatter about the canonical link?
Sam Ortiz: Yep. Planning: 1) repro in staging, 2) swap to /cdn/runtime/sample-manifest.json, 3) add frontmatter canonical and small changelog note. If rehost required I’ll open PR -> @Jordan Lee for review.
Jordan Lee: Happy to review. If it's just a link update, feel free to self-merge after CI and docs smoke test (:white_check_mark:). If rehost, ping infra for CDN ACLs.
Priya Nair: Heads-up — the docs-scan flagged other 'example.redwood.ai' URLs in the onboarding folder. Might be worth a quick grep and replace in the same PR.
Sam Ortiz: Good call. I'll include a minimal sed in the PR description: `git grep -l "example.redwood.ai" docs/onboarding | xargs sed -i "s|https://example.redwood.ai|https://cdn.redwood.ai|g"`
docs-bot: Created issue #4521 in docs-triage: "Onboarding KB: example.redwood.ai links 403 in staging" (assignee: Sam Ortiz).
Maya Chen: Thanks. Sam — can you post the PR link here when ready and mark the thread with :shipit: once merged?
Sam Ortiz: Will do. ETA ~2h.
Jordan Lee: Thanks everyone. Short wins like this are great for onboarding flow improvements.
Maya Chen: Agreed — cheers!
